```{r run-dsa, include=FALSE}
# Define DSA parameters for Model B (excludes p_tlr)
dsa_pars <- c("c_drug_nivo", "c_drug_FLOX", "c_test_NGS", "c_test_CT",
              "c_test_blood", "c_other_visit", "c_other_baseline",
              "c_other_follow", "c_other_last", "u_np", "u_p",
              "p_crp", "p_tmb_braf")

# Calculate min/max ranges (+/- 20%)
dsa_ranges <- data.frame(
  pars = dsa_pars,
  min = unlist(l_params_base[dsa_pars]) * (1 - DSA_mult),
  max = unlist(l_params_base[dsa_pars]) * (1 + DSA_mult),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Cap utility values at 1.0
for (param in c("u_np", "u_p")) {
  idx <- which(dsa_ranges$pars == param)
  if (length(idx) > 0) dsa_ranges$max[idx] <- min(dsa_ranges$max[idx], 1.0)
}

# Cap prevalence values between 0 and 1
for (param in c("p_crp", "p_tmb_braf")) {
  idx <- which(dsa_ranges$pars == param)
  if (length(idx) > 0) {
    dsa_ranges$min[idx] <- max(dsa_ranges$min[idx], 0.0)
    dsa_ranges$max[idx] <- min(dsa_ranges$max[idx], 1.0)
  }
}

# Ensure cost parameters are non-negative
cost_params <- c("c_drug_nivo", "c_drug_FLOX", "c_test_NGS", "c_test_CT",
                 "c_test_blood", "c_other_visit", "c_other_baseline",
                 "c_other_follow", "c_other_last")
for (param in cost_params) {
  idx <- which(dsa_ranges$pars == param)
  if (length(idx) > 0) dsa_ranges$min[idx] <- max(dsa_ranges$min[idx], 0)
}

# Run base case
cat("Running base case...\n")
base_result <- model_fun(l_params_base)
base_result$NMB <- base_result$Effect * WTP - base_result$Cost
base_inmb <- base_result$NMB[base_result$Strategy == "crp"] -
             base_result$NMB[base_result$Strategy == "control"]

cat("Base case iNMB (CRP vs Control):", round(base_inmb), "EUR\n")

# Run DSA: compute incremental NMB (CRP - Control) for each parameter variation
tornado_data <- data.frame()

for (i in 1:nrow(dsa_ranges)) {
  param_name <- dsa_ranges$pars[i]
  cat("Testing:", param_name, "\n")

  for (val_type in c("min", "max")) {
    params_varied <- l_params_base
    params_varied[[param_name]] <- dsa_ranges[[val_type]][i]

    result <- model_fun(params_varied)
    result$NMB <- result$Effect * WTP - result$Cost

    inmb <- result$NMB[result$Strategy == "crp"] -
            result$NMB[result$Strategy == "control"]

    tornado_data <- rbind(tornado_data, data.frame(
      Parameter = param_name,
      Value = val_type,
      inmb = inmb,
      inmb_diff = inmb - base_inmb,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
}

# Assign parameter groups
group_map <- list(
  drug_costs = c("c_drug_nivo", "c_drug_FLOX"),
  test_costs = c("c_test_NGS", "c_test_CT", "c_test_blood"),
  other_costs = c("c_other_visit", "c_other_baseline", "c_other_follow", "c_other_last"),
  utilities = c("u_np", "u_p"),
  prevalence = c("p_crp", "p_tmb_braf")
)

tornado_data$group <- sapply(tornado_data$Parameter, function(p) {
  for (g in names(group_map)) {
    if (p %in% group_map[[g]]) return(g)
  }
  return("other")
})

# Pivot to wide format for tornado plot
tornado_wide <- data.frame()
for (param in unique(tornado_data$Parameter)) {
  min_row <- tornado_data[tornado_data$Parameter == param & tornado_data$Value == "min", ]
  max_row <- tornado_data[tornado_data$Parameter == param & tornado_data$Value == "max", ]

  if (nrow(min_row) > 0 && nrow(max_row) > 0) {
    tornado_wide <- rbind(tornado_wide, data.frame(
      Parameter = param,
      Min_diff = min_row$inmb_diff,
      Max_diff = max_row$inmb_diff,
      Range = max(abs(min_row$inmb_diff), abs(max_row$inmb_diff)),
      group = min_row$group,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
}

# Order by impact
tornado_wide <- tornado_wide[order(tornado_wide$Range), ]
tornado_wide$Parameter <- factor(tornado_wide$Parameter, levels = tornado_wide$Parameter)

cat("DSA complete.", nrow(tornado_wide), "parameters tested.\n")
```

```{r create-tornado, fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
if (nrow(tornado_wide) > 0) {
  # Parameter group colors for y-axis labels
  group_colors <- c(
    "drug_costs" = "#E41A1C",
    "test_costs" = "#377EB8",
    "other_costs" = "#4DAF4A",
    "utilities" = "#984EA3",
    "prevalence" = "#FF7F00"
  )

  label_colors <- group_colors[tornado_wide$group]
  label_colors[is.na(label_colors)] <- "black"

  # Friendly parameter labels
  param_labels <- c(
    "c_drug_nivo" = "Nivolumab cost",
    "c_drug_FLOX" = "FLOX cost",
    "c_test_NGS" = "NGS test cost",
    "c_test_CT" = "CT scan cost",
    "c_test_blood" = "Blood test cost",
    "c_other_visit" = "Visit cost",
    "c_other_baseline" = "Baseline cost",
    "c_other_follow" = "Follow-up cost",
    "c_other_last" = "End-of-life cost",
    "u_np" = "Utility (progression-free)",
    "u_p" = "Utility (progressed)",
    "p_crp" = "CRP prevalence",
    "p_tmb_braf" = "TMB/BRAF prevalence"
  )

  tornado_wide$Label <- ifelse(
    tornado_wide$Parameter %in% names(param_labels),
    param_labels[as.character(tornado_wide$Parameter)],
    as.character(tornado_wide$Parameter)
  )
  tornado_wide$Label <- factor(tornado_wide$Label,
                               levels = tornado_wide$Label[order(tornado_wide$Range)])

  p_tornado <- ggplot(tornado_wide) +
    geom_col(aes(x = Label, y = Min_diff),
             fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.8, width = 0.7) +
    geom_col(aes(x = Label, y = Max_diff),
             fill = "darkred", alpha = 0.8, width = 0.7) +
    coord_flip() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Change in Incremental NMB (EUR)"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = scales::label_currency(prefix = "\u20AC", big.mark = ",")
    ) +
    # Annotate base case iNMB
    annotate("text",
      x = 0.5, y = max(abs(c(tornado_wide$Min_diff, tornado_wide$Max_diff))) * 0.6,
      label = paste0("Base case iNMB = \u20AC", format(round(base_inmb), big.mark = ",")),
      size = 3, hjust = 0, color = "gray30"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = label_colors),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )

  print(p_tornado)
} else {
  cat("DSA results not available.\n")
}
```

```{r save-figure, include=FALSE}
if (nrow(tornado_wide) > 0) {
  figs_dir <- here("figs")
  if (!dir.exists(figs_dir)) {
    dir.create(figs_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }

  ggsave(
    filename = here("figs", "figure2.png"),
    plot = p_tornado,
    width = 9,
    height = 7,
    dpi = 300,
    bg = "white"
  )

  cat("Figure saved to:", here("figs", "figure2.png"), "\n")
}
```
